scope: Targeted independent identity corroboration for the 19 Garris Letter 2 signer rows not resolved by the repository crosswalk's first pass.
method: Each row preserves the signer name and printed institutional/presbytery context from Letter 2 and cites an independent church, ministry, denominational, or institutional source that identifies the same person in the same ministry context. This receipt establishes identity only; it does not add theological or ideological claims beyond the separately modeled act of signing Letter 2.
guardrails: Letter 2 remains the primary source for the signature itself.
Independent sources below are used only to establish person identity/context.
Current or later roles do not imply that the person held the identical title on June 6, 2024 unless the cited source says so.
No signer is assigned National Partnership, AMR, or other network membership from co-signature or institutional proximity.
The Letter 2 Jeff White is independently tied to Redeemer Downtown and must not be merged with the distinct Letter 1 Jeff White row from New City Fellowship / Rio Grande merely by name.
